style: Original hand-painted 2D fantasy adventure game illustration. Cozy theatrical storybook fantasy with expressive believable shapes, restrained ink contours, tactile gouache brushwork, readable silhouettes, warm amber highlights against desaturated teal and slate shadows, muted rust and parchment accents. Adventurous, humane, lightly humorous, never grotesque. Consistent professional game art direction, not photorealistic, not anime, not pixel art, no text, no logos, no UI. Soft upper-left amber key light and cool ambient fill.

assets.prompt: Wide landscape background plate, approximately 16:9, eye-level camera. Modest medieval town archive hall after rain, plaster and timber walls, tall shelves of bound ledgers, a sturdy desk with an open handwritten index ledger (only indistinct marks, no readable writing). A CLOSED heavy wooden cellar door with a simple visible iron lock, and a separate OPEN passage revealing a rainy cobbled courtyard. Dry hall floor with just damp footprints near entrance. No people or portraits or creatures. Keep lower middle and sides uncluttered to layer waist-up character sprites. No treasure, no exposed land deeds, no extra story objects. A real environment illustration, not a contact sheet.

Wide landscape background plate, approximately 16:9, eye-level camera. Rainy small medieval archive courtyard: wet cobblestones, plaster and timber walls matching an amber-lit archive hall, modest courier wooden wagon with a practical canvas canopy for shelter from rain, open passage back into the archive. No people, no animals, no NPC baked into background. Not a tavern or palace. Keep foreground spacious and uncluttered for layered character avatars. Cozy amber light from the hall against cool teal rain. No text, no signs.

Wide landscape background plate, approximately 16:9, eye-level camera. Stone vaulted cellar under a modest medieval town archive. Murky water knee-high for an adult human, about 45 cm, partially submerges lowest steps. Stone staircase rises to open doorway with warm amber light in rear. One CLOSED dark wooden document chest with a plain iron lock sits above water on a waist-high stone pedestal. No visible contents, no loose documents or treasure or floating books. Keep roomy foreground for overlay characters. Cool teal floodwater and warm reflected light. No people or creatures. Readable attractive environment, mild urgency, not horror.

Single centered waist-up character sprite on a genuinely transparent background, portrait format 3:4. Rin, an adult male elf rogue and sailor. Slim agile build, pointed elf ears clearly visible, olive skin, angular friendly face, hazel eyes, dark tousled hair tied into a short knot, a small brass ear cuff. Weathered forest-teal short leather coat, muted rust scarf, simple brown leather shoulder straps, practical sailor knot on belt. Distinctive expressive eyebrows. Neutral attentive expression with mouth closed and a hint of mischievous confidence. Three-quarter view facing slightly toward viewer, shoulders and hands fully within frame, arms relaxed. No weapon drawn, no held props, no background, no ground plane, no drop shadow, no halo, no portrait frame. Original appearance, not resembling a celebrity. Same framing must be usable for expression swaps.
